scenarios.scenario_abstract: Across classroom, reading, phone, and computer work, [X] repeatedly wears and cleans the same prescription glasses for nearsightedness, then uses bright outdoor PE to notice where that familiar pair stops meeting open-air eye-protection and visibility needs before considering separate or replacement eyewear.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在课堂、阅读、手机和电脑任务中，[X]会反复佩戴并清洁同一副近视处方眼镜，又在明亮的户外体育课中观察这副熟悉眼镜在哪些方面无法满足露天护眼和视野需求，从而考虑另一副或替换用眼镜。
examples: using Outdoor when bright PE and recurring open-air activity define the missing role
keeping the current prescription pair's actual UV protection unknown
not turning computer-lab use into Laboratory/Clinical

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a solo Maui week, [X] adds polarized sunglasses to a packing plan with repeated snorkeling, exposed coastal walks, historical stops, resort time, sunsets, and rental-car travel, comparing whether one eyewear role can cover sustained open-air use and sunlit driving without being confused with the separate snorkel mask.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 独自前往毛伊岛一周时，[X]会把偏光太阳镜加入行李计划；行程包括多次浮潜、暴露的海岸步行、历史景点、度假村活动、日落和租车出行，并判断同一副眼镜能否兼顾长时间户外活动和日间驾驶，同时不与独立的浮潜面镜混为一谈。
examples: using Outdoor for beaches, coastal walks, and exposed historical stops
using Driving only when the road segment and daylight visibility are kept central
not assigning Night Driving merely because the itinerary includes sunsets

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While packing sunglasses for snow glare and planning to drive among waterfalls, glaciers, dark roads, hot pools, and city stops, [X] compares eyewear roles for exposed daytime terrain and sustained road visibility while keeping cold-weather condensation and low light as separate constraints.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为雪地眩光携带太阳镜，并计划驾车往返瀑布、冰川、昏暗道路、温泉和城市停靠点时，[X]会比较哪些眼镜适合白天的开阔地形与长时间道路观察，同时把寒冷环境结雾和弱光作为独立约束。
examples: using Outdoor when snow glare and exposed landscape time dominate
using Driving when the self-drive route and road visibility dominate
reserving Night Driving for an explicitly low-light road segment rather than all Iceland travel

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For an R&B stadium concert, [X] considers sunglasses for the bright arrival, then plans to locate the car in a dark parking area and drive home through evening traffic, treating daytime event eyewear and low-light road eyewear as different occasion roles rather than one all-purpose pair.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 参加 R&B 体育场演唱会时，[X]会考虑在明亮入场阶段佩戴太阳镜，之后还要在昏暗停车区找到车辆并穿过晚间车流回家，因此会把白天活动眼镜与弱光道路眼镜视为不同场合角色，而不是一副万能眼镜。
examples: using Outdoor for the exposed pre-show arrival
using Night Driving for the explicitly dark parking and drive-home stage
not treating dark-tinted sunglasses as suitable low-light driving eyewear

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a first Mediterranean shore-fishing trip around Alexandria's rocks and harbor walls, [X] adds polarized sunglasses to tackle, bait, and first-aid planning and evaluates an eyewear role for prolonged open-air glare, fine water detail, slippery footing, salt spray, and repeated handling near hooks.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为首次在亚历山大附近礁石和港墙边进行地中海岸钓做准备时，[X]会把偏光太阳镜与钓具、鱼饵和急救用品一并规划，并评估适合长时间户外眩光、水面细节、湿滑落脚点、盐雾和鱼钩附近反复操作的眼镜用途。
examples: using Outdoor for the sustained shore and harbor-wall activity
keeping polarization and lens material as separate attributes
not assigning Tactical/Field merely because hooks and rocks require care

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before learning motorcycle startup, handlebar and foot controls, low-speed practice on private ground, and the permit transition to public roads, [X] adds helmet-compatible eye protection and evaluates it specifically for wind, debris, head movement, and repeated riding checks.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 学习摩托车启动、手脚控制、私人场地低速练习以及持证进入公共道路之前，[X]会先把与头盔兼容的护眼装备加入清单，并针对气流、飞散物、头部转动和反复骑行检查来评估其用途。
examples: using Motorcycle Riding for the learner's actual practice and later legal road use
checking helmet interface, moving-air clarity, and retention
not mapping Night Driving from a general high-beam explanation

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While installing a newly bought bracketed shelf on a concrete wall for the first time, [X] adds safety glasses to the masonry drill, level, anchors, and dust-cleanup tools and evaluates the eyewear for a precision home workshop task involving fast particles, fine powder, and continuous visibility of pencil marks.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 第一次把新买的带支架置物架安装到混凝土墙上时，[X]会将安全眼镜与砌体钻头、水平尺、膨胀件和清尘工具一并准备，并针对会产生飞散颗粒和细粉尘、且需持续看清铅笔标记的精细家庭安装作业评估眼镜。
examples: using Industrial/Workshop for the drilling and anchoring workflow even though it occurs at home
keeping certification and material as separate product checks
not assigning Laboratory/Clinical because dust and tools are involved

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For aging peach and apple trees, [X] builds a recurring organic spray plan with copper, dormant oil, sulfur, and spinosad and selects protective eyewear for pump spraying in calm weather, overhead mist and branches, residue cleanup, and reuse across several growth stages.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为老桃树和苹果树制定周期性有机喷洒计划时，[X]会纳入铜制剂、休眠油、硫磺和多杀菌素，并为无风天气下的泵式喷洒、头顶雾滴和枝条、残留物清理以及多个生长阶段的重复使用选择护眼装备。
examples: using Horticulture for the recurring orchard treatment cycle
keeping chemical compatibility as a separate lens-material or product-rating question
not assigning Laboratory/Clinical merely because named products are measured and mixed

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For quad biking in Namibia, [X] uses provider-issued goggles and evaluates the eyewear for an exposed field activity with moving grit, intense brightness, helmet fit, rapid terrain reading, and equipment returned after the session rather than treated as a personal pair.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在纳米比亚沙漠参加四轮摩托活动时，[X]会使用运营方提供的护目镜，并针对飞动砂砾、强光、头盔适配、快速辨认地形和活动后归还装备的露天野外活动来评估眼镜用途，而不把它当作个人专属眼镜。
examples: using Tactical/Field for the exposed terrain and moving-debris role without claiming military use
keeping provider-issued goggles at category level
not assigning Motorcycle Riding to a recreational quad activity

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While removing recurring mold from a humid bathroom ceiling, [X] adds safety goggles to ventilation, mask, gloves, overhead spraying, scrubbing, and exhaust-fan repair and evaluates the eyewear for a home maintenance task where droplets, loosened debris, fog, and upward viewing compete.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 清除潮湿浴室天花板反复出现的霉斑时，[X]会把安全护目镜与通风、口罩、手套、头顶喷洒、刷洗和排风扇维修一起规划，并针对液滴、松动碎屑、结雾和持续仰视相互影响的家庭维护作业评估眼镜用途。
examples: using Industrial/Workshop for the maintenance and protective-equipment role
keeping anti-fog and lens material as separate attributes
not assigning Laboratory/Clinical merely because cleaning solutions are used
